reason: A DeepSeek Harness appearance customization plugin providing theme presets, editable color roles, image or video backgrounds, transparency and blur controls, and persistent appearance settings.

summaries.zh: 用于自定义 DeepSeek Harness 外观的插件，支持主题配色、图片或视频壁纸、透明度与毛玻璃效果调节，并持久化保存设置。
summaries.en: An appearance customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness with theme colors, image or video backgrounds, opacity and blur controls, and persistent settings.

capabilities: Customizes theme colors and interface appearance
Applies user-selected image or video backgrounds
Persists appearance settings in browser localStorage and video data in IndexedDB
Loads image or video media from user-provided URLs
Exports and imports color settings through clipboard text
